text:
Alex: FYI corpcard charge at hotel posted under weird merchant name so it got flagged as "OTHER" by Concur. Hotel folio shows room $312.00 + minibar $18.25, but the card transaction came through as 'BLUEMART RETAIL' $330.25. Attached: folio.pdf and pic_receipt.jpg.
Priya - Finance: Ugh merchant mismatch. For reconciliation we need the hotel folio that maps the BLUEMART descriptor to the property. If you have a folio with the hotel's legal name and address that will do. Also need a short note in Concur indicating this is a room + incidental bundle.
Alex: I have folio.pdf with hotel name and address. Uploaded to Concur expense EXP-2026-0612-5543 and added a note: "merchant descriptor differs (BLUEMART RETAIL) — matches hotel folio page 2; manager approved."
Sam - Manager: Approved. Alex, can you confirm minibar was personal or on company? I saw you had client dinner that night.
Alex: Minibar was personal. I split the Concur lines: room $312.00 (TL_LODGING) and minibar $18.25 (PERSONAL_MEAL). But Concur auto-mapped the whole $330.25 to OTHER which broke approval flow.
Priya - Finance: OK we can manually split during processing. Two requests: 1) please add a one-line explanation in the expense: "folio matches BLUEMART descriptor; minibar personal, split line items." 2) include folio page that shows folio number and guest name. Once done we'll process room portion to business category and mark minibar as non-reimbursable unless clarified.
Alex: Done. Concur notes updated and folio page uploaded. EXP-2026-0612-5543 now shows two line items.
CardOps: Created internal ticket CORP-CARD-11440 to request merchant descriptor mapping from payment processor. If the processor confirms BLUEMART is the hotel's acquirer name we'll whitelist it to prevent future flags.
Priya - Finance: Thanks. One more policy thing: for future, if merchant descriptor looks unrelated, grab folio + front desk receipt at checkout time. If it's a corporate room we can still reimburse once we can match. We'll process reimbursement for room after manager sign-off.
ExpenseBot: Expense EXP-2026-0612-5543 submitted by Alex at 2026-06-12 18:02 UTC. Status: under review by finance.
Sam - Manager: Sounds good. Priya, flag if you need me to re-approve after you split the lines.
Priya - Finance: I'll handle the split and post a comment here. Expect room reimbursement in next pay cycle; minibar marked personal so not reimbursed. Marking for audit trail. :white_check_mark:
